note: P0R-22: generator declarations the container_metadata check may attribute. Everything here is a self-declaration — unsigned metadata a file states about itself, which anyone can plant or strip. aigc_producers maps a GB 45438-2025 implicit label's ContentProducer (exact name, or a code containing the producer's unified social credit code) to a service name; an unlisted producer is reported as a fact without attribution. sei_vendor_strings are substrings of an H.264/HEVC SEI user_data_unregistered payload that a generation service writes. tool_field_brands are generator names that, in a generator-specific field (encoder/software/©too/TSSE/ISFT), are a moderate self-declaration only. aigc_generated_labels lists the Label values read as 'AI-generated'; any other value is a fact only. The table is versioned: a change bumps 'version' (part of the scan cache key).

aigc_producers.source: threat_catalog_2026-10-17 §4.1 (Kling 3.0/IMAGE 3.0 outputs: AIGC JSON Label "1", ContentProducer "kling" or "0011"+"91110108335469089C"(Kuaishou unified social credit code)+"10100"); github.com/Aariyan007/kling-label-detector (tested 2026-10-09/12)

sei_vendor_strings.source: threat_catalog_2026-10-17 §4.1 (Kling outputs: H.264 SEI user data contains "kling-ai"); github.com/Aariyan007/kling-label-detector (tested 2026-10-09/12)

unregistered.aigc_producers: Tongyi (Alibaba), Jimeng (ByteDance), Hunyuan (Tencent) also write GB 45438 labels (threat catalog §7 row 3) but no producer code verified from a sample file is recorded here (2026-10-17) — their labels are read and reported without attribution.
unregistered.sei_vendor_strings: x264/x265 option strings are encoder facts (every ffmpeg edit has them), never generator strings.
